modules.name: Vinyl Countdown
modules.description: Eight vinyl stages in record order: lathe (hot cut, elliptic, HF limit, groove echo), RIAA cut/play curves, pressing generation and wear, inner-groove tracing, stylus/cartridge, off-centre wow, valve phono preamp (step-up, hum, ground lift) and a drifting second deck. Two assignable CV inputs, bypass, 20 presets. Live audio, max 6 ms latency (plus up to 100 ms on deck B)

modules.name: Scratch
modules.description: Human scratch sequencer: 12 gestures on 8 steps or a trigger, HUMAN timing drift and SLOPPY hands, scratching live audio (rolling or grabbed) or a WAV; live audio passes through between gestures

modules.name: Studio
modules.description: The record before the lathe: console (drive, transformer iron, crosstalk), master tape (saturation, head bump, 7.5/15/30 ips, flutter, azimuth), Dolby A around the tape with level error and the classic never-decoded / double-decoded mistakes, and vari-mu glue. Two assignable CVs, bypass, presets

modules.name: Listening Room
modules.description: The record after the preamp: power amp (valve, solid state, cheap crossover distortion, loudness), eight speakers from phone to club stack, a room with bass modes and a next-door wall, and the listener's ears (distance, head angle, the morning after). Two assignable CVs, bypass, presets

modules.name: On Air
modules.description: A record played on FM radio, simulated end to end: broadcast processing by era, pre-emphasis and clipper, stereo multiplex with pilot, FM at about 768 kHz, multipath and motion (picket fencing), noise, a next station input 100/200 kHz away, and a receiver (tuning, IF filter, discriminator, pilot PLL, stereo blend, high cut). Two assignable CVs, bypass, presets
